reason: I might send a café the free link once to see what happens, but I'm not paying for a pass from a beta app with a small team I've never heard of. Most of my collabs are free food anyway, so coupon counts don't change much for me yet.
objection: Who is actually behind Mitra? If a café uses my coupon and still doesn't pay, or the counts are wrong, who do I complain to? Nobody in my WhatsApp groups has mentioned it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing other creators in my WhatsApp groups say a café actually paid them cash because of their Mitra customer count.
